name: Project 8
summary: Project 8 develops cyclotron-radiation emission spectroscopy for direct neutrino-mass measurements. It infers a beta electron’s kinetic energy from microwave radiation while the electron orbits in a magnetic field.
detection_principle: Electrons trapped in a magnetic field radiate at an energy-dependent cyclotron frequency. A microwave receiver follows the radiation track in time, measuring the beta spectrum without extracting the electron into a conventional spectrometer.

results.summary: Project 8 demonstrated a tritium beta spectrum and a first CRES neutrino-mass limit.

science_scope: This is a laboratory kinematic measurement of the effective electron-flavour neutrino mass. Its observable differs from the effective Majorana mass in neutrinoless double-beta decay and the sum of neutrino masses inferred from cosmology.
